title.narrative: Improved decent work employment opportunities through the development of coherent policies aligned to international standards on labour statistics in Kiribati

description.narrative:
ILO is supporting Kiribati in producing, reporting and using relevant statistics, particularly on topics like new work relationships, informal economy and SDG indicators relating to decent work, following the latest statistical standards adopted at the International Conference of Labour Statisticians (ICLS), and contributing to the achievement of SDG targets on data availability and measurements of progress on sustainable development.
The ILO has been providing technical assistance to the Ministry of Tourism, Industry, and Cooperatives regarding cooperative policy and legislative reform since early 2023, at the Ministry's request. The Ministry is currently at a crucial stage, where consultations with stakeholders on the draft policy are essential before it can be finalised. After extensive consultation, the ILO collaborated with the Ministry to support the finalization and launch of the National Cooperative Policy throughout 2025. This collaboration aligns with the ILO's Global Business recommendation to assist countries in developing the Social and Solidarity Economy (SSE), of which cooperatives are a key part.
